concept.title: Upgrading Templates
concept.shortdesc: When you upgrade to Contract Management from a version earlier to Contract Management 7.0, you

conbody.p: When you upgrade to Contract Management from a version earlier to Contract Management 7.0, you must upgrade all of your templates. The following items are updated by the Migration Manager to support the Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) field:

ul.li: All clause references are updated to point to the UUID instead of the Salesforce ID

conbody.p: Although Term Exceptions are also updated with UUIDs, they cannot be automatically migrated. You have to copy these term exception records from the source to other orgs (if multi-org ecosystem is involved) by data loader or other means after the upgrade.

ul.li: Close all Microsoft Office products before running an upgrade.
